description: Monitor an asset selection; fire a RunRequest at a named job when any matched asset gets a new materialization. Bridges an upstream asset event to a job-shaped target, for cases where post_processing's deps:/automation_condition: can't apply (a bare @dg.job isn't an asset).

outputs.description: Fires a run of the configured job when a monitored asset materializes.

monitored_selection.label: Monitored Selection
monitored_selection.description: Asset selection to monitor: explicit key list, the Dagster selection DSL (tag:/group:/kind:/boolean composition), '*' for everything, or a bare fnmatch glob. Resolved against sibling assets in the same defs folder.

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Name of the job to run via RunRequest when a monitored asset updates.

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: 'running' or 'stopped' -- initial status of the sensor.

name: Asset To Job Trigger Sensor
